Full skill text at 5★
Deals (600% ATK + 60000) DMG to all enemies and restores HP equal to 10% of the DMG dealt to all allies with the [Loong's Wrath] tag. If all enemies hit are non-Bosses, grants all allies [Mirage Silk Garment] (reduces DMG taken by 25% and increases DMG dealt by 25%; when inflicted with a Control effect, removes all Control effects and [Mirage Silk Garment] from self) for 2 turns; meanwhile, reduces all enemies' Mastery by 30% and Crit DMG by 30% for 2 turns, and increases all allies' Mastery and Crit DMG by the same amounts for 2 turns. This effect can trigger only once before each ally acts. When [Loong's Wrath] is inflicted, Phantom Seahorse gains 10% Energy and 1 layer of [Tidal Essence] (each layer increases Phantom Seahorse's Skill DMG by 10%, up to 5 layers). When Phantom Seahorse proactively casts a skill, if it has 5 layers of [Tidal Essence], consumes all [Tidal Essence], causing the DMG dealt this time to additionally ignore enemies' [Shield] and [DMG Immunity]. Crit is guaranteed for DMG dealt by Phantom Seahorse's active skills. Before proactively casting a skill, cleanses all Debuffs from all allies and inflicts 1 layer of [Loong's Wrath] on all enemies. When a battle starts, if 5 allies with the [Loong's Wrath] tag are deployed, Phantom Seahorse grants all allies [Tidal Protection] (reduces non-Crit DMG taken to 1) and [Azure Sanctuary] (reduces Crit DMG taken to 1) for 1 turn. If a target already has both [Tidal Protection] and [Azure Sanctuary], their durations are extended by 1 turn instead. Before casting an active skill each time, additionally increases the Crit DMG of the ally with the highest ATK by 20%, up to 5 layers, and gains Crit DMG equal to 50% of that ally's Crit DMG (up to 400% Crit DMG can be gained; refreshes upon duplicate acquisition). When a battle starts, for each ally with the [Loong's Wrath] or [Resonance] tag deployed, Phantom Seahorse gains 20% Energy and increases all allies' Mastery by 10%. When a battle starts, grants all allies [Mirage Silk Garment] for 2 turns. If 5 allies with the [Loong's Wrath] tag are deployed, each time after Phantom Seahorse casts a skill, extends [Tidal Protection] and [Azure Sanctuary] on all allies by 1 turn. When an ally loses [Mirage Silk Garment], increases their Turn Meter by 30%. If 5 allies with the [Loong's Wrath] tag are deployed, while the ally with the highest initial ATK has [Mirage Silk Garment], their Turn Meter increases by 20% at the end of each other ally's turn, and their skill CDs are reduced by 1 turn at the beginning of their own turn. Before Phantom Seahorse proactively casts a skill, inflicts [Dream-Drowning Vortex] on all enemies (when a non-Boss unit cumulatively gains [Loong's Wrath] 3 times, reduces their Turn Meter by 20%, up to 2 triggers; gaining [Loong's Wrath] again resets the trigger count) for 2 turns. If the target is a Boss, additionally increases their Resonance DMG taken by 30% for 2 turns and increases all allies' Turn Meters by 20%.
Source: game files.
